title: Web Development on iPhone and iPad | Acode
description: Write HTML, CSS, and JavaScript on iPhone and iPad with Acode. Preview local websites and choose local or remote tools for your project.
heroHeadline: Build and preview websites on iOS
heroSubheadline: Edit HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in a project folder, preview your changes, and use additional tools when your project needs them.
problemPoints: Write HTML, CSS, and JavaScript on iPhone and iPad with Acode. Preview local websites and choose local or remote tools for your project.
solutionPoints: Acode for iPhone and iPad is currently marked Coming soon on the website. Check the home page for release availability.
featuresHeadline: Web Development on iPhone and iPad

features.title: Start with a local website
features.description: Keep your HTML document, stylesheet, scripts, and images together so relative links resolve in the preview.

features.title: Check the browser result
features.description: Use Acode’s preview while editing. Test in your target browsers as well before publishing a website.

features.title: Choose where to build
features.description: The local terminal uses emulation. Framework development servers and builds depend on runtime compatibility; use a remote environment for demanding or unsupported projects.

setupSteps.title: Create a project folder
setupSteps.description: Create an HTML file and keep its stylesheets, scripts, and assets alongside it.

setupSteps.title: Open the HTML preview
setupSteps.description: Preview the document in Acode and check layout, links, and assets.

setupSteps.title: Make a small change
setupSteps.description: Edit a style or a line of text, save it, and check the updated result.

setupSteps.title: Validate before publishing
setupSteps.description: Test on the screen sizes and browsers your visitors use. Publishing your site is a separate step.

faqs.question: Do I need Node.js for a simple website?
faqs.answer: No. A basic HTML, CSS, and browser JavaScript project can be edited and previewed without Node.js.

faqs.question: Can I run any framework locally?
faqs.answer: Not every dependency or build tool is compatible with the iOS terminal. Check your project’s requirements and use a remote development machine when needed.
